about_the_game:
Start from scratch in a peaceful village.
Grow your own food, sell your products, buy your car and become part of a close-knit community. Build friendships, fall in love with a village girl, and start a family. Live a simple, fulfilling life surrounded by nature.

🚜 Drive your car freely through fields, forests, and village roads.

🌾Dig the Soil then Start Planting

🌾 Plant and grow crops across seasons – from seeding to harvest. 

💕Build relationships with villagers – including romance with charming girls. Learn their stories, give gifts, and maybe even start a family.

🛠️ Features

🚜 Free Driving – Hop in your car and freely explore your surroundings: lush forests, quiet fields, and the village roads.

🌾 Farming from Scratch – Start with just a few seeds and grow your farm into a thriving business.

🌱 Seasonal Crops – Plant and harvest different crops across all four seasons, each with its own visuals and timing.

🧑‍🌾 Land Preparation – Dig, water, and fertilize your soil to ensure maximum yield.

🐄 Animal Care – Raise livestock like cows and chickens. Feed them daily, collect their products, and unlock new animals.

🏡 Home Customization – Decorate and expand your house with furniture, colors, and styles that suit you.

💕 Relationship & Romance – Befriend villagers and build meaningful relationships. Some may even lead to romance and family life.

🎣 Fishing – Cast your line in lakes, rivers, and hidden ponds. Each area has unique fish to discover.

🛒 Village Economy – Sell your harvest, animal goods, and fish at the local market to earn coins and grow your farm.

📆 Dynamic World – Experience changing weather, a day-night cycle, and seasonal events that bring the village to life.

🎉 Festivals & Events – Join in on special village festivals, competitions, and story events throughout the year.

🌍 Immersive World – Handcrafted details, atmospheric sound design, and cozy visuals bring your farming village to life

name: Farm Life: A Village Story

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-13100 / AMD Ryzen 3 4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 4GB / AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 6 GB/ AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Farm Life: A Village Story offers a peaceful escape from city life. Grow crops, build bonds with villagers, and create a home of your own. As seasons pass, your small farm becomes a thriving, heartfelt village life.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Turkish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
